text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #18273f

g.text: The tested arithmetic operators preserve every Hecke block exactly. The local active projector P crosses those blocks.

g.text: Why W143 couples less: q4 and q6 both have sign −, so their commutator blocks vanish exactly (teal outlines).

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #18273f

g.text: Overlap is neither an intersection dimension nor a probability. Heatmaps describe [A,P], not arithmetic transitions between Hecke blocks.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #55627a

g.text: All plotted magnitudes and coupling ranks are numerical diagnostics in a metric-orthonormal frame (seed 143). Signs and block preservation are exact on packaged matrices.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #55627a

g.text: Entries shown as 0.00 are rounded; only the stated sign cancellations are asserted exact here. MTFT v0.26.2.
